items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: I'm familiar with Fabian, but I doubt if he won't testify to it, you know.

ctx.x: Well, I didn't care much for him for the fact that he didn't care much for me. He made it pretty miserable on me when I... All the nine years I worked over there for some reason or other. Of course, he was a strict old country Russian type, you know. And I don't know, it seems to me he had a grudge against something and he was taking it out on people. He made it tough for a lot of good musicians over there. He's teaching at the University of Miami now. Married into big money, you know. As a conductor, he never…

items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: Old Fabian, we used to call him Beanie because he came from Boston.

ctx.x: I thought I told you how to say that, didn't I? You did, but I wanted to get it down on tape so I could practice. Okay. Now let's see, Savitsky was in Indianapolis, huh?
Yes, he was. Old Fabian, we used to call him Beanie because he came from Boston. Dick? Mm-hmm. That's all I'm being.
